# Overview

Runs the French extraction from CHILDES tokens through negation coding to `french_data/processed_data/french_tokens_processed.feather`; uses `french` as the working directory with `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, and reuses matching raw caches. Review `french_pas_noun_spotcheck.csv` after the first run, add confirmed noun token IDs to `french_pas_noun_manual_ids`, and rerun from target-word definition.

# Setup

Loads `childesr`, `tidyverse`, and `arrow`, configures knitr, and creates `french_raw_dir` and `french_processed_dir`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  error = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE
)
library(childesr)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r directories}
french_db_version <- "2026.1"
french_force_download <- FALSE

french_data_root <- "french_data"

french_raw_dir <- file.path(french_data_root, "raw_data")
french_processed_dir <- file.path(french_data_root, "processed_data")

dir.create(french_raw_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(french_processed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Load Data

Selects CHILDES source corpora and imports tokens into `french_all_tokens` for annotation.

## Select Corpora

Selects the French collection in `french_target_collection` for CHILDES release `french_db_version`.

```{r collections}
french_target_collection <- "French"
```

## Import Data

Downloads or reuses French collection tokens in `french_all_tokens` and validates required columns and the cached row count.

```{r import_tokens}
# Only use caches belonging to the pinned release and the same query.
french_feather_path <- file.path(french_raw_dir, "all_french_tokens.feather")
french_csv_path <- file.path(french_raw_dir, "all_french_tokens.csv")
french_source_info_path <- file.path(french_raw_dir, "all_french_tokens_source.rds")

french_query_roles <- NULL

french_query_info <- list(
  db_version = french_db_version,
  collection = sort(french_target_collection),
  role = sort(french_query_roles),
  token = "%",
  replace = TRUE
)

french_cache_info <- if (file.exists(french_source_info_path)) {
  tryCatch(readRDS(french_source_info_path), error = function(e) NULL)
} else {
  NULL
}

french_cache_matches <- is.list(french_cache_info) &&
  identical(french_cache_info$query, french_query_info)

french_loaded_from_cache <- FALSE

if (!french_force_download && french_cache_matches && file.exists(french_feather_path)) {

  cat(sprintf(
    "Loading verified childes-db %s Feather cache...\n",
    french_db_version
  ))

  french_all_tokens <- arrow::read_feather(french_feather_path)
  french_loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else if (!french_force_download && french_cache_matches && file.exists(french_csv_path)) {

  cat(sprintf(
    "Loading verified childes-db %s CSV cache...\n",
    french_db_version
  ))

  french_all_tokens <- readr::read_csv(
    french_csv_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  french_loaded_from_cache <- TRUE

} else {

  cat(sprintf(
    "Downloading French tokens from childes-db %s...\n",
    french_db_version
  ))

  french_all_tokens <- childesr::get_tokens(
    collection = french_target_collection,
    role = french_query_roles,
    token = "%",
    replace = TRUE,
    db_version = french_db_version
  )
}

# Avoid saving an empty/failed download.
if (is.null(french_all_tokens) || nrow(french_all_tokens) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No tokens returned. Check the query messages and collection name; ",
    "no cache was saved."
  )
}

# Check that the expected columns are available.
french_required_columns <- c(
  "id", "target_child_id", "target_child_age", "transcript_id", "utterance_id",
  "token_order", "gloss", "part_of_speech", "speaker_role",
  "speaker_code", "utterance_type"
)

french_missing_columns <- setdiff(
  french_required_columns,
  names(french_all_tokens)
)

if (length(french_missing_columns) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Required columns missing: ",
    paste(french_missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Confirm that the cached data matches its source record.
if (
  french_loaded_from_cache &&
  !isTRUE(nrow(french_all_tokens) == french_cache_info$row_count)
) {
  stop(
    "Cache row count does not match its source record. ",
    "Set french_force_download <- TRUE and rerun."
  )
}

if (!french_loaded_from_cache) {

  cat("Saving the new data and its release/query information...\n")

  arrow::write_feather(french_all_tokens, french_feather_path)
  readr::write_csv(french_all_tokens, french_csv_path)

  saveRDS(
    list(
      query = french_query_info,
      downloaded_at_utc = format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      childesr_version = as.character(utils::packageVersion("childesr")),
      row_count = nrow(french_all_tokens)
    ),
    french_source_info_path
  )

} else if (!file.exists(french_feather_path)) {

  arrow::write_feather(french_all_tokens, french_feather_path)
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Loaded %d tokens from %d children.\n",
  nrow(french_all_tokens),
  french_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()
))
```

# Token Processing

Filters `french_tokens` by `target_child_age` and assigns speaker, age, and utterance-type fields before negation coding.

## Filter Ages and Count Exclusions

Filters `french_all_tokens` to finite `target_child_age` values from 0 to under 72 months and records row and child counts in `french_exclusions`. Lowercases `gloss` before filtering.

```{r exclusions}
french_n_tokens_before_exclusions <- nrow(french_all_tokens)
french_n_chi_before_exclusions <- french_all_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

french_tokens <- french_all_tokens %>%
  mutate(gloss = tolower(gloss))

french_tokens <- french_tokens %>%
  filter(is.finite(target_child_age))
french_n_tokens_after_finite_age <- nrow(french_tokens)
french_n_chi_after_finite_age <- french_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

french_tokens <- french_tokens %>%
  filter(target_child_age >= 0, target_child_age < 72)
french_n_tokens_after_age_range <- nrow(french_tokens)
french_n_chi_after_age_range <- french_tokens$target_child_id %>% unique() %>% length()

french_exclusions <- tibble(
  n_tokens_before_exclusions = french_n_tokens_before_exclusions,
  n_after_finite_age = french_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  n_after_age_range = french_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  missing_or_nonfinite_age =
    french_n_tokens_before_exclusions - french_n_tokens_after_finite_age,
  outside_age_range =
    french_n_tokens_after_finite_age - french_n_tokens_after_age_range,
  n_chi_total = french_n_chi_before_exclusions,
  n_chi_after_finite_age = french_n_chi_after_finite_age,
  n_chi_after_age_range = french_n_chi_after_age_range
)

french_exclusions
```

## Save Exclusion Records

Saves `french_exclusions` and the age-filtered `french_tokens` as CSV files in `french_raw_dir`.

```{r save_exclusions}
readr::write_csv(
  french_exclusions,
  file.path(french_raw_dir, "exclusions_french_summary.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  french_tokens,
  file.path(french_raw_dir, "french_tokens_excluded.csv")
)
```

## Assign Speaker Roles

Maps target-child roles to `child` and every other role, including missing values, to `parent` in `french_tokens$speaker`.

```{r speaker_roles}
french_tokens <- french_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = case_when(
      str_to_lower(as.character(speaker_role), locale = "en") == "target_child" ~ "child",
      TRUE ~ "parent"
    )
  )
```

## Calculate Age in Months

Calculates `french_tokens$age` as the floor of `target_child_age` in months.

```{r age}
french_tokens$age <- french_tokens$target_child_age %>% floor()
```

## Recode Utterance Types

Recodes question, imperative, and disrupted labels from `utterance_type` into `french_tokens$utterance_type`, leaving unlisted values unchanged.

```{r utterance_types}
# Prepare the utterance_type categories for this study based on the utterance_types in childes-db
## Categories: declarative, imperative, interrogative, and other
french_tokens$utterance_type <-
  recode(french_tokens$utterance_type,
         question = "interrogative",
         `broken for coding` = "other",
         `imperative_emphatic` = "imperative",
         interruption = "other",
         `interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `missing CA terminator` = "other",
         `no break TCU continuation` = "other",
         `question exclamation` = "interrogative",
         `quotation next line` = "other",
         `quotation precedes` = "other",
         `self interruption` = "other",
         `self interruption question` = "interrogative",
         `trail off` = "other",
         `trail off question` = "interrogative"
  )
```

# Define Target Words

Defines `french_negator_forms`, noun-`pas` overrides, fixed-expression lists, and interjections used in later matching.

```{r function_words}
# Negator forms: name = form in the transcript, value = counted category.
french_negator_forms <- c(pas = "pas", non = "non", nan = "non")

# Noun pas ("step"): POS tags treated as nouns. "neg" does not match.
french_noun_pos_regex <- "^(n|noun)(:|$)"

# Token IDs (childes-db `id`) of pas confirmed as nouns in the spot-check
# but not tagged as nouns (e.g. transcripts without %mor).
french_pas_noun_manual_ids <- integer(0)

# Words before pas that send it to the noun spot-check (determiners, numbers).
french_det_num_before_pas <- c(
  "un", "une", "le", "la", "l'", "les", "des", "du", "ce", "cet", "ces",
  "mon", "ton", "son", "mes", "tes", "ses", "notre", "votre", "nos", "vos",
  "leur", "leurs", "quelques", "plusieurs", "chaque",
  "petit", "petits", "grand", "grands", "gros", "premier", "premiers",
  "dernier", "derniers",
  "deux", "trois", "quatre", "cinq", "six", "sept", "huit", "neuf", "dix",
  "onze", "douze", "vingt", "cent", "mille"
)

# Fixed expressions with pas that do not negate.
# Accented forms are written as \u escapes so matching works under any locale.
french_problem_words <- c("problème", "probleme", "problèmes", "problemes",
                          "souci", "soucis")

# "pas mal": excluded as "not bad / quite a lot", but kept as negation when it
# means "doesn't hurt" (after a form of faire/avoir, not followed by "de").
# Set to FALSE to exclude every "pas mal", as the rule document is worded.
french_hurt_verbs <- c("fait", "fais", "font", "faisait", "fera", "ferait",
                       "ai", "as", "a", "avait", "avais", "ont", "avez", "avons")

# Words that do not count as "other content" before a tag-question non.
french_interjections <- c("ah", "oh", "eh", "euh", "bah", "ben", "mais", "hein")
```

# Classify Negation

Builds a word-level context table, excludes non-negating `pas`, assigns scope, and maps the results back to `french_tokens`.

## Build Word Context

Normalizes `french_tokens$gloss`, splits compound forms into `french_words`, and adds neighboring words and `neg_form` for matching.

```{r negation_words}
french_tokens <- french_tokens %>%
  mutate(
    .row_id = row_number(),
    gloss_norm = gloss %>%
      str_replace_all("[’ʼ`]", "'") %>%
      str_replace_all("-", "_") %>%
      str_replace_all("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}'_+ ]", "") %>%
      str_squish()
  )

french_words <- french_tokens %>%
  select(.row_id, token_id = id, target_child_id, transcript_id, utterance_id,
         token_order, speaker, utterance_type, gloss_norm, part_of_speech) %>%
  mutate(part = str_split(coalesce(gloss_norm, ""), "[_+ ]+|(?<=')")) %>%
  unnest_longer(part, indices_to = "part_order") %>%
  filter(part != "") %>%
  group_by(.row_id) %>%
  mutate(n_parts = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(transcript_id, utterance_id, token_order, part_order) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  mutate(
    w_order = row_number(),
    n_w     = n(),
    prev2 = lag(part, 2), prev  = lag(part),
    nxt   = lead(part),   nxt2  = lead(part, 2),
    neg_form = unname(french_negator_forms[part]),
    # Words before this one that are neither interjections nor non/nan.
    content_before = lag(cumsum(!(part %in% c(french_interjections, "non", "nan"))),
                         default = 0L)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Exclude Noun pas and Fixed Expressions

Flags noun `pas` and fixed expressions in `french_words$excl_reason` using POS tags, manual token IDs, and neighboring words.

```{r negation_exclusions}
french_words <- french_words %>%
  mutate(
    is_pas = neg_form %in% "pas",
    pas_mal_hurt = french_keep_pas_mal_hurt &
      prev %in% french_hurt_verbs & !(nxt2 %in% "de"),
    excl_reason = case_when(
      is_pas & n_parts == 1 &
        str_detect(coalesce(part_of_speech, ""), french_noun_pos_regex) ~ "noun_pas_pos",
      is_pas & token_id %in% french_pas_noun_manual_ids                 ~ "noun_pas_manual",
      is_pas & nxt %in% "grave"                                         ~ "pas_grave",
      is_pas & nxt %in% "de" & nxt2 %in% french_problem_words           ~ "pas_de_probleme",
      is_pas & nxt %in% "mal" & !pas_mal_hurt                           ~ "pas_mal"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-is_pas, -pas_mal_hurt)
```

## Assign Negation Scope

Assigns `sentential` to remaining `pas` and specified `non` constructions, and assigns `discourse` to other included `non` in `french_words$negation_scope`.

```{r negation_categorization}
french_words <- french_words %>%
  mutate(
    is_non = neg_form %in% "non",
    # Specific constructions first, so "tu veux ou non ?" is ou_non, not a tag.
    non_rule = case_when(
      is_non & nxt %in% "plus"                                ~ "non_plus",
      is_non & prev %in% "ou"                                 ~ "ou_non",
      is_non & prev %in% "que" & !(prev2 %in% "parce")        ~ "que_non",
      is_non & w_order == n_w & content_before > 0 &
        utterance_type %in% "interrogative"                   ~ "tag_question"
    ),
    negation_scope = case_when(
      is.na(neg_form) | !is.na(excl_reason) ~ NA_character_,
      neg_form == "pas"                     ~ "sentential",
      !is.na(non_rule)                      ~ "sentential",
      TRUE                                  ~ "discourse"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-is_non)
```

## Map Negation to Tokens

Aggregates `french_words` into `n_pas`, `n_non`, scope, rules, exclusions, and function-word labels on `french_tokens`.

```{r negation_tokens}
french_neg_by_token <- french_words %>%
  filter(!is.na(neg_form)) %>%
  group_by(.row_id) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pas = sum(neg_form == "pas" & !is.na(negation_scope)),
    n_non = sum(neg_form == "non" & !is.na(negation_scope)),
    n_non_sentential = sum(neg_form == "non" & negation_scope %in% "sentential"),
    n_non_discourse  = sum(neg_form == "non" & negation_scope %in% "discourse"),
    negation_scope = str_c(sort(unique(na.omit(negation_scope))), collapse = "+"),
    negation_rule = str_c(unique(na.omit(non_rule)), collapse = "+"),
    negation_exclusion = str_c(unique(na.omit(excl_reason)), collapse = "+"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(negation_scope, negation_rule, negation_exclusion), ~ na_if(.x, "")))

french_tokens <- french_tokens %>%
  select(-any_of(c("n_pas", "n_non", "n_non_sentential", "n_non_discourse",
                   "negation_category", "negation_scope",
                   "negation_rule", "negation_exclusion"))) %>%
  left_join(french_neg_by_token, by = ".row_id") %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(n_pas, n_non, n_non_sentential, n_non_discourse), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)),
    negation_category = case_when(
      n_pas > 0 & n_non > 0 ~ "pas+non",
      n_pas > 0             ~ "pas",
      n_non > 0             ~ "non"
    ),
    word = coalesce(negation_category, "nonfunction"),
    word_category = if_else(!is.na(negation_category), "Negation", "nonfunction"),
    syncategory = if_else(word_category == "nonfunction", "nonfunction", "Function")
  )

french_tokens %>%
  filter(!is.na(negation_category)) %>%
  count(speaker, negation_category, negation_scope, name = "n_tokens")
```

# Review Noun pas Candidates

Saves `pas` tokens preceded by listed determiners, adjectives, or numbers, with context and current coding, to `french_pas_noun_spotcheck.csv`. Counts their `excl_reason` values for manual noun review.

```{r pas_noun_spotcheck}
french_utt_text <- french_words %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, utterance_id) %>%
  summarise(utt = str_c(part, collapse = " "), .groups = "drop")

french_pas_spotcheck <- french_words %>%
  filter(neg_form %in% "pas",
         prev %in% french_det_num_before_pas | str_detect(coalesce(prev, ""), "^[0-9]+$")) %>%
  left_join(french_utt_text, by = c("transcript_id", "utterance_id")) %>%
  select(token_id, transcript_id, utterance_id, speaker, utt, prev, part, nxt,
         part_of_speech, excl_reason, negation_scope)

readr::write_csv(
  french_pas_spotcheck,
  file.path(french_processed_dir, "french_pas_noun_spotcheck.csv")
)

french_pas_spotcheck %>% count(excl_reason, name = "n_tokens")
```

# Save Processed Data

Saves `french_tokens` to `french_data/processed_data/french_tokens_processed.feather` for downstream counts and plots.

```{r save_processed_data}
write_feather(
  french_tokens %>% select(-.row_id),
  file.path(french_processed_dir, "french_tokens_processed.feather")
)
```
